messages.subject: How to define a "ragged array" (array of arrays with different sizes)?
parts:
Hi all,

the setting is like I have multiple tasks, and the tasks have different numbers of observations. To store the observations I think I need an array of arrays with different length. How to write this in stan? Thanks.

Best,
Ziyuan

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] How to define a "ragged array" (array of arrays with different sizes)?
parts:
Check out the section of the manual titled "Representing Ragged
Arrays in Stan". It's in the clustering chapter. There's no
built-in data type for it (yet), so it's a bit of effort.

- Bob
